misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen forecast record containing its specification, issuance time, evidence cutoff, and linked realized outcome could make forecast accuracy and timing assessable. The supplied settlement prices alone cannot show whether any prior forecast was accurate or whether a decision failure occurred.
misses.decision_reference: No linked prior forecast specification, issuance time, or eligible evidence cutoff is supplied for the settlement records. See EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES and EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE in the supplied registry.
misses.decision_relevance: Without forecast-to-outcome lineage, target-time prices cannot establish what was forecast beforehand or support a demonstrated decision miss.
misses.miss_description: The supplied records contain confirmed target-time BTC/ETH mark prices, but no linked prior forecast specification, issuance time, or decision-time evidence cutoff. This supports an auditability data gap only, not a demonstrated forecast or decision failure.
misses.missing_history_problem: Frozen forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked matured outcomes are absent. Settlement target timestamps are adjudication times, not decision or source-observation timestamps.
misses.outcome_reference: Supplied FORECAST_SETTLEMENT_EVIDENCE records, including EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36; the records provide confirmed target-time prices but are not linked to prior forecast specifications.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
